description: Offline evaluation corpus for S1-05 semantic tool discovery. Synthetic and redaction-safe: no real paths, credentials, or model identifiers. `class` is the gating dimension (a case may declare `alsoClasses` membership); `subset` stays a legacy filter. Bump `corpusVersion` whenever the cases change. The human target set per case is `expectedNames`; `admitted: false` on a candidate means the scope's permission gate denies it, so it must never be admitted to the pool or activated.
